research_direction: Direction 8 (Anguita et al. 2026, arXiv:2602.20062) at 1B: the midtrained checkpoint IS the SFT stage's initialization, so how far midtraining moved the weights is a controllable variable that should decide whether the later stage can still REFINE the planted features or is stuck reusing frozen ones. Three complete 2x2s at midtrain learning rates 2e-6 / 2e-5 / 1e-4 — a 25x span in measured weight displacement — with the corpus, token budget, update count and SFT stage held fixed. Every cell WITHIN an arm shares its arm's LR, including the clean-Dolmino reference midtrain, so the contrast is content and not LR. The submitted 2x2 is the 5x (1e-4) arm.

cells.R: clean Dolmino midtrain at LR 1e-4 -> clean Dolci SFT (reference; a real trained cell)
cells.M: live-mix midtrain at LR 1e-4 -> clean Dolci SFT
cells.S: clean Dolmino midtrain at LR 1e-4 -> mixed SFT
cells.T: live-mix midtrain at LR 1e-4 -> mixed SFT

base_model_arm: reported for context only; never used as the reference cell
backend: scimt.train hf backend (single GPU, full parameter, no FSDP)
gate1_selfcheck: passed locally with the pod's floors and tolerance

sweep.lr_2e-6: rel L2 from base 0.00276; interaction +0.0125 rate
sweep.lr_2e-5: rel L2 from base 0.01291; interaction +0.0400 rate
sweep.lr_1e-4: rel L2 from base 0.06982; interaction +0.0075 rate  <- THIS submission
